data.headline: Graco stroller maker Newell seeks tariff details before resuming China shipments
data.summary: NEW YORK (Reuters) -Newell Brands is looking for more clarity on how newly lowered U.S. tariffs will be applied before potentially resuming shipments of its Graco baby strollers and child car seats from China, a spokesperson said on Monday.  Atlanta-based manufacturer Newell, whose products range from coffee makers to pens, paused purchase orders on its China-made goods, which are primarily Graco baby products, in the short term to avoid 145% levies on shipments, CEO Chris Peterson told Reuters last month.
